description.value: Destiny Bay Grocers is a year-round convenience store on Highway 3A serving the small lakeside communities of Sanca, Destiny Bay, and Boswell on Kootenay Lake. Part of the Destiny Bay Resort property (the store sits across the highway from the resort itself), it stocks a full grocery range at supermarket prices, cold beer, wine, liquor, ice, and seasonal fresh produce. Cyclists on this remote Kootenay corridor will also find fresh-baked bread, buns, and the store's locally famous butter tarts, plus a modest selection of fishing and camping supplies.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms this is a year-round convenience/grocery store at 11942 3A Hwy, Destiny Bay BC V0B1A3, phone 250-223-8055 — matching OSM tags. The site explicitly lists ice among products sold and describes a broad grocery inventory; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or cycling infrastructure anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null. The store is part of Destiny Bay Resort but operates as a distinct retail entity across the highway from the resort.
concerns: OSM address lacks city and postal code; website supplies 'Destiny Bay BC V0B1A3' — address field updated accordingly.
No cycling infrastructure (bike rack, washrooms, water) is mentioned anywhere; these amenities are unverifiable without an on-site visit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A confirmed year-round grocery store on a remote Kootenay highway corridor with a broad resupply inventory and credit/debit card acceptance — a genuine waypoint for touring cyclists with few alternatives nearby.
enrichment_extras.notes: Store is affiliated with Destiny Bay Resort but operates as a separate retail unit across Highway 3A from the resort. Fresh baking (bread, buns, butter tarts, pies) is prepared in the resort kitchen and sold at the store.
